# T57.ai

> T57 is an AI-native digital trade platform for food. It connects verified farmers, processors, traders, buyers, financiers, service providers and regulators on one trade record, from quote to payment. T57 does not lend or hold funds; finance, escrow and insurance come from licensed partners.

T57 works with the Islamic Organization for Food Security (IOFS), an OIC institution, under a 10-year memorandum of understanding, and has signed more than 150 memoranda and letters of intent across 67 countries. Founding markets: Saudi Arabia, UAE, India, Malaysia and Türkiye.

## Who we serve

- [Who We Serve](https://t57.ai/who-we-serve): T57 exists to connect everyone who grows, makes, buys, finances and regulates food on one trusted record.
- [Governments and Regulators](https://t57.ai/who-we-serve/governments): Live trade data, food-security alerts and transparent tenders, in one view for ministries and agencies.
- [Financiers and Investors](https://t57.ai/who-we-serve/financiers): Every deal comes with verified parties, documents and shipment data, from deal to settlement.
- [Sellers and Exporters](https://t57.ai/who-we-serve/sellers): Find buyers, agree terms and get paid, with finance and logistics on one platform.
- [Traders and Aggregators](https://t57.ai/who-we-serve/traders): Match supply and demand faster, with verified partners, live prices and finance for each deal.
- [Buyers and Importers](https://t57.ai/who-we-serve/buyers): Compare verified suppliers, track every shipment and pay only when terms are met.
- [Manufacturers and Enterprises](https://t57.ai/who-we-serve/enterprises): Source from verified producers, see price moves early and run every contract in one place.
- [Food Processors](https://t57.ai/who-we-serve/food-processors): Steady raw materials from verified farms, with quality checks and finance built in.
- [Cooperatives and FPOs](https://t57.ai/who-we-serve/cooperatives): Pool produce, reach bigger buyers and pay members faster, with every trade on record.
- [Partners and Collaborators](https://t57.ai/who-we-serve/collaborators): Development partners, associations and institutions reach the whole food chain through one platform.
- [Service Providers](https://t57.ai/who-we-serve/service-providers): Inspection, logistics, legal and advisory firms are matched to live trades that need them.
- [Farmers and Producers](https://t57.ai/who-we-serve/farmers): Reach verified buyers directly, see market prices and get paid faster.

## Why T57

- [Why T57](https://t57.ai/why-t57): Join, discover, finance, settle and close every trade on one AI-native platform, so every actor from farm to fork can see, trust and finance each transaction.
- [Club Membership](https://t57.ai/why-t57/club-membership): Verified food-trade club that matches vetted counterparties, reducing fraud and defaults across every global agri transaction.
- [RFQ Bidding](https://t57.ai/why-t57/rfq-bidding): Get comparable quotes from verified suppliers, and turn the best one into a contract.
- [Virtual Trade Desk](https://t57.ai/why-t57/virtual-trade-desk): A full trade desk for every member, with AI doing the groundwork and people deciding.
- [Market & Price Intelligence](https://t57.ai/why-t57/market-intelligence): See prices, supply and risk by origin before you quote, buy or plan.
- [Trade Finance](https://t57.ai/why-t57/trade-finance): One verified deal file, several lenders competing to fund your food trade.
- [Digital Asset-Based Funding](https://t57.ai/why-t57/nft-funding): Turn verified trade documents into digital assets that funders can trust and finance.
- [eLC in 15 Minutes](https://t57.ai/why-t57/elc-15-minutes): Electronic letters of credit, issued in about 15 minutes once your application is approved.
- [Escrow Payments](https://t57.ai/why-t57/escrow-payments): Your money moves only when the goods do, with escrow released at agreed milestones.
- [Alternative Payments](https://t57.ai/why-t57/alternative-payments): Settle food trades in stablecoins, digital assets or bullion-backed payments, where the law allows.
- [Digital Bank](https://t57.ai/why-t57/digital-bank): Hold, pay and settle in any currency, near-instantly, inside your food trade.
- [Document Management & Audit Trail](https://t57.ai/why-t57/document-audit-trail): Every document, approval and milestone of a trade, on one tamper-evident record.

## Capabilities

- [Capabilities](https://t57.ai/capabilities): Run every part of a food trade, from first quote to final payment, on one record.
- [Trade Execution](https://t57.ai/capabilities/trade): Turn a food trade opportunity into an agreed, delivered and documented deal.
- [RFQ & Trade Execution](https://t57.ai/capabilities/trade/rfq): Send one structured request, compare verified quotes and execute the deal you choose.
- [Virtual Trade Desk](https://t57.ai/capabilities/trade/virtual-trade-desk): Give your business the trade desk of a global trading house, without hiring one.
- [Contract Farming](https://t57.ai/capabilities/trade/contract-farming): Agree next season's crop today, with buyers, growers and finance on one record.
- [Government Tenders](https://t57.ai/capabilities/trade/government-tenders): Find, answer and deliver public food tenders as a verified supplier.
- [Traceability](https://t57.ai/capabilities/trade/traceability): Prove where your food came from, how it was handled and who touched it.
- [LLM-Based Orders](https://t57.ai/capabilities/trade/whatsapp-orders): Order food the way you already talk to suppliers, by WhatsApp, voice or chat.
- [Trust & Payments](https://t57.ai/capabilities/finance/trust-payments): Pay and get paid with confidence, on terms both sides can see and trust.
- [Escrow & Trade Assurance](https://t57.ai/capabilities/finance/escrow): Hold payment safely until the goods, the quality and the documents are right.
- [Digital Wallet & Payments](https://t57.ai/capabilities/finance/digital-wallet): One wallet for every trade payment, in any currency, linked to every invoice.
- [Electronic Letter of Credit](https://t57.ai/capabilities/finance/elc): Letters of credit built from your contract, issued digitally and presented without paper.
- [Banking & Money Movement](https://t57.ai/capabilities/finance/banking): Bank, convert and move money across borders, in any currency, where you trade.
- [Digital Banking](https://t57.ai/capabilities/finance/digital-bank): Business banking built around your food trade, opened with your T57 Passport.
- [Any-Currency Accounts & Remittance](https://t57.ai/capabilities/finance/multi-currency): Hold, convert and send money in any currency, at rates you see before you pay.
- [Crypto & Digital Assets](https://t57.ai/capabilities/finance/crypto-banking): Settle trades in stablecoins, digital assets or gold-backed tokens, through regulated partners.
- [Financing & Capital](https://t57.ai/capabilities/finance/financing): Fund every stage of your food trade, from planting and production to shipment and sale.
- [Trade & Supply Chain Finance](https://t57.ai/capabilities/finance/supply-chain-finance): Get working capital at every step of the food chain, from lenders competing for your trade.
- [Asset-Based Fundraising & Tokenization](https://t57.ai/capabilities/finance/crowdfunding): Raise capital against real food assets, from verified trades to warehouse stock and farm equipment.
- [Risk & Protection](https://t57.ai/capabilities/finance/risk-protection): Protect every trade against loss, default and disruption, with cover built from the trade record.
- [Logistics & Fulfilment](https://t57.ai/capabilities/logistics): Move food from farm or factory to buyer, with freight, tracking and customs on one record.
- [Intelligent Logistics Network](https://t57.ai/capabilities/logistics/network): Compare and book vetted freight, cold-chain and warehousing partners, matched to each trade.
- [Real-Time Shipment Tracking](https://t57.ai/capabilities/logistics/tracking): Know where your food is, what condition it is in and when it will arrive.
- [Customs & Documentation Hub](https://t57.ai/capabilities/logistics/customs): Prepare export and import documents once, and clear food through customs faster.
- [Intelligence & Data](https://t57.ai/capabilities/intelligence): Trade with the full picture: prices, supply, counterparties and markets, inside every deal.
- [Live Food Price Index](https://t57.ai/capabilities/intelligence/price-index): Current food prices by product, grade and origin, built from real trades.
- [AI Negotiations Engine](https://t57.ai/capabilities/intelligence/ai-negotiations): Negotiate every food deal with market data and AI preparation behind you.
- [Equipment Rental Marketplace](https://t57.ai/capabilities/agritech/equipment-rental): Rent tractors, harvesters, cold storage and processing equipment when you need it.

## Common questions

- [What is T57?](https://t57.ai/): T57 is AI-native digital trade infrastructure for the food industry. It brings verification, quotes, contracts, finance access, insurance, inspection and logistics onto one trade record for verified members.
- [Who can join T57?](https://t57.ai/): Any business in the food chain can apply, including farmers, fishers, processors, manufacturers, brands, traders, importers, wholesalers, supermarkets and HoReCa buyers. Every member is verified before trading.
- [Who can join T57?](https://t57.ai/who-we-serve): Any business or institution in the food chain can apply, from farmers and fishers to processors, brands, traders, importers, supermarkets, HoReCa buyers, lenders, insurers, service providers and government bodies.
- [Why does T57 verify every member?](https://t57.ai/who-we-serve): Verification lets every member trade with confidence. It also gives lenders and insurers the trusted information they need to support a trade.
- [How is T57 different from other food trade platforms?](https://t57.ai/why-t57): T57 is an AI-native ecosystem, working with IOFS and ASEAN, that brings trade, finance, logistics and policy-grade data together on one verified platform.
- [Why do the IOFS and ASEAN partnerships matter to me as a trader?](https://t57.ai/why-t57): They translate into faster onboarding, clearer rules of origin and better access to tenders and sovereign buyers, because T57 aligns with the institutions that set food security and trade priorities.
- [How does the T57 trust score help farmers and producers, cooperatives, and FPOs reduce risk?](https://t57.ai/why-t57/club-membership): The trust score helps these groups assess whether prospective buyers, aggregators, processors, or service partners have the legitimacy, financial stability, trade history, and relationship strength needed to support dependable transactions. This reduces the risk of engaging with weak or opaque counterparties.
- [Why is the T57 ID useful for financiers and investors, partners, collaborators, governments, and regulators?](https://t57.ai/why-t57/club-membership): The T57 ID provides these stakeholders with a structured view of whether an organization has been verified across key trust factors, including compliance, field validation, references, and ecosystem reputation. That makes it easier to evaluate risk and engage with businesses whose credentials are supported by a more advanced process than standard marketplace profiles or basic business identifiers.
- [Who can respond to an RFQ on T57?](https://t57.ai/why-t57/rfq-bidding): Only verified members whose products, capacity and markets match the request. Buyers can also invite specific suppliers.
- [Can sellers see each other's bids?](https://t57.ai/why-t57/rfq-bidding): No. Each bid is visible only to the buyer, which keeps pricing fair and confidential.
- [Is the Virtual Trade Desk a person or software?](https://t57.ai/why-t57/virtual-trade-desk): Both. The Trade Desk is software that matches, prices, drafts and screens, supported by T57's trade desk team for cases that need human review.
- [Does the Trade Desk negotiate for me?](https://t57.ai/why-t57/virtual-trade-desk): No. It gives you matches, price data and checks. You negotiate and decide.
- [Where does T57's price data come from?](https://t57.ai/why-t57/market-intelligence): From public market sources and anonymized, aggregated trade data on T57. No individual member's prices are shared.
- [Can I use the data without trading on T57?](https://t57.ai/why-t57/market-intelligence): Market intelligence is part of T57 membership and is built to support trading on the platform.
- [Does T57 provide the finance?](https://t57.ai/why-t57/trade-finance): No. T57 does not lend or hold client funds. It sends your verified deal file to licensed lenders, who decide whether to fund the trade and on what terms.
- [What kinds of finance can I request?](https://t57.ai/why-t57/trade-finance): Pre-shipment and post-shipment finance, receivables finance and letters of credit, through participating banks and finance companies, including Shariah-compliant options.
- [Is this cryptocurrency?](https://t57.ai/why-t57/nft-funding): No. A tokenized trade document is a digital record of a real asset, such as an invoice or warehouse receipt. It is not a currency.
- [Which documents can be tokenized?](https://t57.ai/why-t57/nft-funding): Trade documents on a verified T57 trade record, such as invoices, warehouse receipts and bills of lading, where local law recognizes electronic trade documents.
- [What does "15 minutes" mean?](https://t57.ai/why-t57/elc-15-minutes): It is the target time for a partner bank to issue the electronic LC after your application has been approved. Approval itself follows the bank's own credit process.
- [Does T57 issue letters of credit?](https://t57.ai/why-t57/elc-15-minutes): No. Letters of credit are issued by licensed partner banks. T57 prepares the application from your trade record and connects you to them.
- [Who holds the money in escrow?](https://t57.ai/why-t57/escrow-payments): A licensed escrow partner. T57 does not hold client funds.
- [What happens if there is a dispute?](https://t57.ai/why-t57/escrow-payments): Release pauses automatically, and the dispute is handled under the contract and the partner's rules. Release resumes once it is resolved.
- [Are alternative payments available in every country?](https://t57.ai/why-t57/alternative-payments): No. They are offered only where local law allows, through regulated partners. Members in other countries settle through banks, escrow or letters of credit.
- [Does T57 hold my crypto or gold?](https://t57.ai/why-t57/alternative-payments): No. Custody, conversion and settlement are handled by licensed partners. T57 records the payment on the trade record.
- [Is T57 a bank?](https://t57.ai/why-t57/digital-bank): No. Digital banking services on T57 are provided by licensed partners. T57 connects them to your verified profile and trade record.
- [Which currencies can I hold?](https://t57.ai/why-t57/digital-bank): Any currency your trade needs. T57's banking partners hold, convert and settle across currencies, so you can pay suppliers and get paid by buyers in their own currency.
- [Who can see my trade documents?](https://t57.ai/why-t57/document-audit-trail): Only the parties you authorize for that trade, such as your counterparty, lender, insurer or inspector. Access is recorded in the audit trail.
- [Are documents stored on the blockchain?](https://t57.ai/why-t57/document-audit-trail): No. Documents are stored securely, and a digital fingerprint of each key record is anchored on the ledger. This proves the document has not changed without exposing its contents.
- [Do I have to use every capability on every trade?](https://t57.ai/capabilities): No. Members choose the capabilities each trade needs. Because they share one record, adding a service later does not mean starting again.
- [Who provides finance, payments and insurance?](https://t57.ai/capabilities): Licensed partners. T57 does not lend, hold client funds, own goods or provide transport. It provides the verification, workflow and trade record that connect these services.
- [Can I use Trade Execution without finance or logistics?](https://t57.ai/capabilities/trade): Yes. You can use RFQs, contracts and traceability on their own, and add finance, insurance or logistics to any trade later.
- [Does T57 sell or buy the goods?](https://t57.ai/capabilities/trade): No. T57 does not own goods. Members trade directly with each other on T57.
- [How long does an RFQ stay open?](https://t57.ai/capabilities/trade/rfq): The buyer sets the deadline. Bids received after it closes are not shown unless the buyer reopens the RFQ.
- [Can I negotiate after receiving bids?](https://t57.ai/capabilities/trade/rfq): Yes. You can ask clarifying questions or request a revised bid from any supplier before you award the contract.
- [Is the Trade Desk included in membership?](https://t57.ai/capabilities/trade/virtual-trade-desk): Yes. Every verified member can use the Trade Desk. Higher membership tiers include deeper data and higher usage.
- [Does the Trade Desk make decisions for me?](https://t57.ai/capabilities/trade/virtual-trade-desk): No. It provides suggestions, drafts and checks. You make every commercial decision.
- [Can individual smallholders use contract farming on T57?](https://t57.ai/capabilities/trade/contract-farming): Yes, usually through a cooperative or producer organization that holds the T57 membership and signs on behalf of its members.
- [What happens if prices change during the season?](https://t57.ai/capabilities/trade/contract-farming): It depends on the contract. Fixed-price, minimum-price and formula-based agreements each handle price movements differently, and the terms are agreed upfront.
- [Does T57 submit bids on my behalf?](https://t57.ai/capabilities/trade/government-tenders): No. T57 helps you find, understand and prepare a response. You submit it through the issuing authority's official channel.
- [Can government buyers use T57 to run tenders?](https://t57.ai/capabilities/trade/government-tenders): Government buyers can invite verified T57 members to bid and track delivery on T57, alongside their own procurement rules and systems.
- [Who adds information to a lot's record?](https://t57.ai/capabilities/trade/traceability): The parties who handle it, such as the producer, processor, inspector and logistics partner, each add the events they are responsible for.
- [Can consumers see traceability information?](https://t57.ai/capabilities/trade/traceability): Yes, if the brand or seller chooses to share it through a link or QR code. Commercial details stay private.
- [Do I need to install anything?](https://t57.ai/capabilities/trade/whatsapp-orders): No. Verified members can order through WhatsApp or T57 chat once their account is linked.
- [What if the AI gets my order wrong?](https://t57.ai/capabilities/trade/whatsapp-orders): You always see a summary before confirming, so you can correct it. Nothing is sent to the supplier until you confirm.
- [Which payment option should I choose?](https://t57.ai/capabilities/finance/trust-payments): Escrow suits most new relationships and domestic wholesale. eLCs suit larger cross-border trades where a bank guarantee is expected. Wallet payments suit trusted, repeat relationships.
- [Can I combine payment options?](https://t57.ai/capabilities/finance/trust-payments): Yes. For example, a deposit can be paid into escrow and the balance under an LC, all on the same trade record.
- [Who holds the money?](https://t57.ai/capabilities/finance/escrow): A licensed escrow partner, in an account separate from T57 and from both trading parties.
- [What does escrow cost?](https://t57.ai/capabilities/finance/escrow): Escrow fees are set by the partner and shown before you agree the contract.
- [Is the T57 wallet a bank account?](https://t57.ai/capabilities/finance/digital-wallet): It is an e-money or payment account provided by a licensed partner. For full banking services, see Digital Banking.
- [Can I pay people who are not on T57?](https://t57.ai/capabilities/finance/digital-wallet): Yes. You can pay external suppliers and service providers by bank transfer from your wallet, subject to the partner's checks.
- [What does "about 15 minutes" mean?](https://t57.ai/capabilities/finance/elc): It is the target time for issuance after the bank has approved your application. Approval follows the bank's normal credit process.
- [Can my own bank issue the LC on T57?](https://t57.ai/capabilities/finance/elc): If your bank is a T57 partner, yes. If not, T57 can connect you to participating banks.
- [Is T57 a bank?](https://t57.ai/capabilities/finance/banking): No. T57 connects verified members to licensed banking and payment partners and links their services to the trade record.
- [Can I keep my existing bank?](https://t57.ai/capabilities/finance/banking): Yes. You can keep using your own bank and connect it to T57, or use T57's partners alongside it.
- [Who provides the bank account?](https://t57.ai/capabilities/finance/digital-bank): A licensed banking partner in your market, under its own terms and regulation.
- [Do I have to move my existing banking?](https://t57.ai/capabilities/finance/digital-bank): No. You can use T57's banking partners alongside your current bank.
- [Which currencies can I hold and send?](https://t57.ai/capabilities/finance/multi-currency): Any currency your trade needs, through T57's banking and payment partners.
- [How long do transfers take?](https://t57.ai/capabilities/finance/multi-currency): Payments between T57 members settle in near real time. External transfers depend on the destination and partner network, and the expected time is shown before you confirm.
- [Is digital-asset settlement legal in my country?](https://t57.ai/capabilities/finance/crypto-banking): T57 shows digital-asset options only where they are permitted for both parties under local rules, through licensed partners.
- [What about price volatility?](https://t57.ai/capabilities/finance/crypto-banking): Stablecoins and gold-backed tokens are designed to reduce volatility, and partners can convert to local currency at the point of payment.
- [Who provides the finance?](https://t57.ai/capabilities/finance/financing): Licensed banks, finance companies, Islamic finance providers and, where permitted, institutional investors. T57 does not lend.
- [What do lenders see?](https://t57.ai/capabilities/finance/financing): Only the deal file you choose to share: your T57 Passport, the contract, counterparties, documents and trade history.
- [How quickly can I receive offers?](https://t57.ai/capabilities/finance/supply-chain-finance): That depends on each lender's process. Because the deal file is already verified, lenders can respond faster than to a standard application.
- [Do I need collateral?](https://t57.ai/capabilities/finance/supply-chain-finance): Many structures rely on the trade itself, through confirmed orders, invoices and escrow repayment, rather than on property or other collateral. Each lender sets its own requirements.
- [Is this the same as crypto?](https://t57.ai/capabilities/finance/crowdfunding): No. A tokenized asset is a digital record of a real asset, such as an invoice or a cold store. It is not a currency.
- [Who can invest?](https://t57.ai/capabilities/finance/crowdfunding): Licensed lenders, and investors eligible under the rules of the licensed fundraising platform and their own country.
- [Does T57 sell insurance?](https://t57.ai/capabilities/finance/risk-protection): T57 connects members to licensed insurers, takaful operators and brokers. Policies are issued by them, under their own regulation.
- [Can I use my existing insurer?](https://t57.ai/capabilities/finance/risk-protection): Yes. You can upload existing policies to the trade record so they can be used with LCs, lenders and claims.
- [Can I use my own freight forwarder?](https://t57.ai/capabilities/logistics): Yes. You can invite your forwarder to the trade record or upload its documents and tracking data.
- [Does T57 support cold-chain shipments?](https://t57.ai/capabilities/logistics): Yes. Cold-chain partners and temperature tracking are available for chilled and frozen goods.
- [How are logistics partners vetted?](https://t57.ai/capabilities/logistics/network): Partners go through business verification, licence and insurance checks, and their performance is rated on recorded shipments.
- [Can I invite my own forwarder?](https://t57.ai/capabilities/logistics/network): Yes. Your existing forwarder can join the trade record and quote alongside network partners.
- [Do I need special tracking devices?](https://t57.ai/capabilities/logistics/tracking): No. T57 uses carrier and port data for all shipments. IoT devices add live temperature and location for sensitive cargo.
- [Who can see my shipment?](https://t57.ai/capabilities/logistics/tracking): Only the parties to the trade and the partners you authorize, such as your lender or insurer.
- [Does T57 file customs declarations?](https://t57.ai/capabilities/logistics/customs): No. Licensed customs brokers file declarations, using the documents prepared on T57.
- [Is pre-clearance available in every country?](https://t57.ai/capabilities/logistics/customs): Pre-clearance depends on each customs authority's procedures. Where it is not available, T57 still sends complete, checked documents to the broker before arrival.
- [Where does T57's data come from?](https://t57.ai/capabilities/intelligence): Public market and trade sources, licensed data partners, and anonymized, aggregated data from trades on T57.
- [Is my trade data shared with other members?](https://t57.ai/capabilities/intelligence): No. Individual trades are never shown. They contribute only to anonymized, aggregated statistics.
- [How is the T57 index calculated?](https://t57.ai/capabilities/intelligence/price-index): It combines public market data, licensed data partners and anonymized, aggregated prices from verified T57 trades, with methods that prevent any single member's price from being identified.
- [How often is it updated?](https://t57.ai/capabilities/intelligence/price-index): It updates as new market data arrives and as verified trades close on T57. Some lines update daily, others weekly, depending on trade volume.
- [Does the AI negotiate on my behalf?](https://t57.ai/capabilities/intelligence/ai-negotiations): No. It prepares and suggests. You decide what to offer, counter or accept, and nothing is sent without your confirmation.
- [Can the other side see the engine's suggestions to me?](https://t57.ai/capabilities/intelligence/ai-negotiations): No. Your briefs and suggestions are private to you.
- [Can I list my equipment for rent?](https://t57.ai/capabilities/agritech/equipment-rental): Yes. Verified members can list equipment, set prices and availability, and choose who can rent it.
- [Who is responsible if equipment is damaged?](https://t57.ai/capabilities/agritech/equipment-rental): The rental terms, condition records and any insurance set out responsibility. Disputes are handled under those terms and the payment partner's rules.
- [How does T57 support national and regional food-security strategies in practice?](https://t57.ai/who-we-serve/governments): Many countries are now expanding strategic reserves and silo capacity to hold months’ worth of essential commodities. T57 complements such physical infrastructure by tracking self-sufficiency, stock levels, and import exposure in real time. This combination of physical reserves and digital intelligence helps governments move from reactive to anticipatory food-security management.
- [Why is it important to channel private and impact capital into agriculture and food systems, beyond public budgets?](https://t57.ai/who-we-serve/governments): Despite agriculture’s historical role in employment and food security, global investors are only now seeking credible, measurable pathways to support food systems as part of their climate and SDG commitments. T57 helps governments present investable, data-backed opportunities, from model support centers to special agri zones and CSR programs, with transparent performance and impact tracking that meets both regulatory and investor expectations.
- [How does T57 handle disputes and reduce risks for financiers and investors?](https://t57.ai/who-we-serve/financiers): T57 reduces risk through its curated club membership model, which ensures vetted, credible counterparties in a high-trust environment. Its virtual trade desk supports execution, manages disputes, oversees documentation, and ensures consistent transaction follow-through for greater investor confidence.
- [Why is food and agri finance an important opportunity for investors now?](https://t57.ai/who-we-serve/financiers): Global food import demand remains enormous: FAO puts the global food import bill at $2.22 trillion in 2025, which underlines the scale and persistence of trade-linked financing needs in food markets.
- [How does T57's virtual trade desk help in disputes and risk management?](https://t57.ai/who-we-serve/sellers): The virtual trade desk acts as a risk manager. In the event of disputes, the desk steps in to mediate, enforce agreed-upon terms and protect the seller's interests. If a buyer becomes insolvent or defaults, T57 shifts to a commission-based recovery and resale approach, helping redirect goods or recover value.
- [How does a platform help with the financing gap?](https://t57.ai/who-we-serve/sellers): Dedicated trade platforms that provide rich transaction and compliance data can lower perceived risk for financiers, improving access to credit and reducing the cost of capital. T57 is designed to expose this data in an auditable way so that funders can underwrite your deals with greater confidence.
- [Can intermediaries join T57?](https://t57.ai/who-we-serve/traders): Yes. Traders and intermediaries are welcome. They are labelled by role so every counterparty knows how the trade is structured.
- [Does T57 lend to traders?](https://t57.ai/who-we-serve/traders): No. T57 does not lend. It sends your deal file to licensed lenders, who decide whether to fund the trade and on what terms.
- [How does T57 verify suppliers?](https://t57.ai/who-we-serve/buyers): T57 runs business and identity checks, compliance screening and, where needed, a physical check of the supplier's premises. Each verified supplier receives a T57 Passport and a role label.
- [Can I buy only from producers?](https://t57.ai/who-we-serve/buyers): Yes. Role labels show whether a supplier is an owner-producer, processor, trader or intermediary, so you can filter for producers.
- [Why do manufacturers and enterprises need a digital trade workflow now?](https://t57.ai/who-we-serve/enterprises): Digital trade workflow is important for countering high losses, volatility, and operational friction in the industry. FAO reports 13.3% food loss before retail, while the World Bank points to ongoing food inflation and uneven commodity movement across markets.
- [How does T57 help reduce procurement risk?](https://t57.ai/who-we-serve/enterprises): T57 helps structure RFQs, centralize bid visibility, and support trade in a more verified counterparty environment. In volatile markets, faster sourcing decisions and improved documentation can help protect supply continuity and margins.
- [Why is digitizing trade especially important for food processors?](https://t57.ai/who-we-serve/food-processors): Processors depend on timely and predictable raw material supplies and operate on tight margins. Supply assurance and trade execution platforms make inputs more predictable, optimize capacity utilization, and protect margins in volatile markets.
- [Does T57 help with working capital and financing challenges?](https://t57.ai/who-we-serve/food-processors): Partner banks, escrow structures, faster eLC workflows, and tokenized-trade capabilities are designed to shorten settlement cycles and connect real trade to innovative finance solutions. For processors, that can mean less cash stuck in transit and more capacity to invest in inventory, maintenance, or growth.
- [Why do cooperatives & FPOs need digital platforms like T57?](https://t57.ai/who-we-serve/cooperatives): Scale alone is not enough. Cooperatives and FPOs need systems that professionalize operations, improve market access, and strengthen bargaining power. When properly supported and organized by platforms like T57, agricultural cooperatives play a critical role in sustainable agrifood systems and food security.
- [How do members gain when their cooperative or FPO wins government tenders or a contract farming agreement?](https://t57.ai/who-we-serve/cooperatives): Government tenders and contract farming agreements lock in demand and timelines, so members know what to produce, when it will be picked up, and at what terms, which leads to more consistent prices and lower post-harvest losses. T57 helps members plan volumes and crop mix, match supply to tender requirements, coordinate logistics and documentation, and track fulfillment and payments in one place, turning tender wins and contracts into a distributed benefit for individual farmers.
- [How do T57 partners help me reach better markets?](https://t57.ai/who-we-serve/collaborators): T57's vetted partners help you meet standards, reliably move produce, and access premium capabilities to help you grow, without having to build these relationships yourself.
- [What kind of partners can I access on T57?](https://t57.ai/who-we-serve/collaborators): You can connect with a diverse range of partners who help you meet complex compliance requirements, reduce logistics losses, unlock financing and insurance, accelerate innovation, and turn more of your effort into predictable, higher-value trade outcomes.
- [How is T57 different from a simple marketplace?](https://t57.ai/who-we-serve/service-providers): T57 is built on verified participants, trade-linked workflows, and governed execution, not just listings and introductions.
- [Can I offer services across borders without a local office?](https://t57.ai/who-we-serve/service-providers): Yes. T57 is designed to help providers engage digitally across regions while reducing friction in discovery, contracting, and payment processes.
- [Why should a farmer or producer use a digital trade platform like T57?](https://t57.ai/who-we-serve/farmers): T57 provides access to verified buyers and transparent payment processes. This reduces uncertainty and improves income realization.
- [What should farmers watch out for in contract farming?](https://t57.ai/who-we-serve/farmers): Contract farming deals are often between stronger buyers and weaker farmers. This could result in unfair terms, over-dependence on a single buyer, or disputes over quality and deductions. Farmers can access T57's expertise to negotiate the best terms.
